reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and link.findOrCreateBank, the unlink column reset is extracted from unlinkAccount into clearAccountBankLink and reused, and the Akahu download is generalised instead of copied for Fintegra.

duplication.why: The rule lives in one assertCanLinkBankAccount/findBankAccountHolder pair, but the same guard call block is repeated in all six provider link functions instead of being owned once by the shared link path.

placement.why: Rules sit in accounts/app.ts next to the link flow and download logic in sync.ts, though the replace-link handling is split between the per-provider guard (early return) and linkBankSyncAccount (clearing the holder).

scope.why: Mostly focused, but includes an unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts and small desktop-client edits although the statement says the client UI is handled separately.

maintainability.why: Small named helpers with a clear comment; a future provider must remember to call the guard itself, and the replaceExistingLink flag is threaded through every provider and two helpers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All providers use linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank and the new shared guard; unlinkAccount now uses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The Akahu downloader is genuinely shared via downloadSingleAccountTransactions and the unlink reset is extracted; the only repetition is the visible assertCanLinkBankAccount call in each provider function.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink plus an if-branch that clears the holder; assertCanLinkBankAccount gains replaceExistingLink (early return) and a closed-account branch; processBankSyncDownload's akahu branch is widened with a fintegra special case.
